We're ready to start Redwood onboarding so we can list Asteria's analytics add-on in AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces. Procurement asked for the checklist we discussed and specifics for purchase order (PO) flow, billing entity, and wiring. Key questions:
- Which legal entity should PO reference for each marketplace (AWS vs Azure vs GCP)?
- Do you require a W-9 or W-8BEN-E for our US/UK entities?
- For marketplace listings, do we need a separate PO for each cloud provider or a single enterprise PO?
- Preferred invoice email and PO reference format (e.g., PO#: AST-XXXX / Redwood account id)

Can you send the vendor onboarding packet and a short timeline? We have Coupa in place and prefer a Net30 once PO is accepted.

Hi Jordan — thanks, and congrats on kickoff. I pulled together the practical checklist and short notes per-cloud. See attachments and summary below.

Quick answers up front:
- Legal entity on PO: use the entity that matches the invoice path below (we have separate invoice recipients per marketplace). I list the exact name to use per provider in the table in the attached checklist.
- Tax forms: If you're US-based we need a W-9 for the US entity; for non-US entities we'll need W-8BEN-E. The attached Redwood_Tax_Docs_Guidance.pdf explains accepted forms and signatures.
- PO split: You can either do one master PO that references all cloud purchases (please include per-provider line items and marketplace SKU references) OR issue separate POs per provider. In practice customers using Coupa often do a single PO with provider line items to simplify accounting; both are acceptable.
- Invoice email and PO format: Include a PO number in the subject and body, use "PO: AST-<incremental>" and reference our HubSpot account id (link below). Invoices should route to the addresses in the checklist.

Attachments included: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx, Redwood_Tax_Docs_Guidance.pdf
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.redwood.com/contacts/AST-2026-07

Proposed two-step timeline:
1) Day 0-3: Legal & tax docs exchange (entity verification + completed onboarding checklist).
2) Day 4-10: Marketplace mapping & PO issuance -> we verify seller ID linkage and enable listing staging.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min call tomorrow to walk Coupa mapping and invoice routing.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Jordan — good questions. Confirming the routing and a few provider-specific notes below (please quote this format in your Coupa line items):

Provider billing recipients (use exact invoice-to address and legal entity):
- AWS Marketplace: Invoice to aws-billing@redwood.com; legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US EIN: 12-3456789). On AWS please include the AWS Marketplace Seller ID and the AWS SKU. We can accept consolidated monthly invoices per seller ID.
- Azure Marketplace: Invoice to azure-billing@redwood.com; legal entity: Redwood Inference Ltd. (UK VAT ID: GB999999999). For Azure, include the Azure Offer ID and the Marketplace Plan code; Azure sometimes requires a separate invoice per subscription—we'll accept monthly consolidation if invoices include subscription IDs.
- GCP Marketplace: Invoice to gcp-billing@redwood.com; legal entity: Redwood Cloud Services LLC (stripe billing mapping). Please include the GCP Marketplace Billing Account ID and the SKU. GCP tends to prefer per-transaction invoices but will accept monthly reconciled statements if requested.

PO formatting guidance (recommended):
- Header: PO#: AST-<YYYYMMDD>-<seq>
- Line items: Provider, SKU/Offer ID, Qty, Unit price, Period (if subscription), Marketplace seller ID
- Invoice subject line: "Invoice PG: AST-<PO#> | Redwood account: AST-2026-07"

Tax and entity notes:
- We'll accept your W-9 for the US entity and W-8BEN-E for UK entity. Kimberly, can you confirm our internal tax team has no additional vendor forms?

Next steps I propose:
- Jordan: return completed checklist + W-9/W-8 by EOD Wed (we can extend if needed).
- Asteria Finance: upload PO to Coupa using the single-PO approach with per-provider line items and send to aws-billing@redwood.com, azure-billing@redwood.com, gcp-billing@redwood.com.
- We'll confirm seller ID linkage and enable staging within 3 business days after receipt.

If you want to route the PO via DocuSign, send to sign@redwood.com (we have a general PO signer on file). Example DocuSign link for templates: https://www.docusign.com/templates/asteria-po-template

I'm looping Kimberly (tax) and Vanessa (marketplace ops) to help with any provider id mapping or exceptions.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Markus Klein
